advisors.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
advisors.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
advisors.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.active_bis_lab_runtime(target_code text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/active_bis_lab_runtime`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.bis_portfolio_lab_artifacts()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/bis_portfolio_lab_artifacts`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.learner_bis_lab_runtime(target_code text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/learner_bis_lab_runtime`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.sponsor_cohort_question_patterns(target_cohort_id text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/sponsor_cohort_question_patterns`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

advisors.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
advisors.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
advisors.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.

findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

boundary: Definer warnings require verification of authenticated scope, not automatic privilege removal. Compromised-password protection is provider-gated on the Pro plan.
